Final Answer: 0.0650

To calculate the annual return, we use the formula:

$$
\text{Annual Return} = \frac{\text{Ending Price} - \text{Beginning Price}}{\text{Beginning Price}} \times 100
$$

Plugging in the given values:

$$
\text{Annual Return} = \frac{105.97 - 99.50}{99.50} \times 100 = \frac{6.47}{99.50} \times 100 \approx 6.50\%
$$

Next, the Sharpe Ratio is calculated using the formula:

$$
\text{Sharpe Ratio} = \frac{\text{Annual Return} - \text{Risk-Free Rate}}{\text{Annualized Standard Deviation of Returns}}
$$

Given the annualized standard deviation of returns is 14.2
